model: No-baseline arousal, CUADS consensus labels, logistic regression (physio_algorithm/train_consensus_arousal.py)
predicts: P(the scan looks like a response to a stimulus people generally rate as arousing)

feature_definitions.scr_rate: SCRs per minute (PhysioAlgorithm: rises >= 0.03 uS after a 1 Hz low-pass, 8 Hz)
feature_definitions.rel_scr_amp: summed SCR rise per minute / median SCL
feature_definitions.scr_max_rel: largest SCR rise / median SCL (0 if none)
feature_definitions.scl_slope_rel: least-squares slope of ln(SCL) over the scan, per minute
feature_definitions.eda_cv: sd of SCL after removing its straight-line trend / median SCL
feature_definitions.hr_slope: least-squares slope of instantaneous HR (clean beats) over time, bpm per minute
feature_definitions.hr_cv: sd / mean of instantaneous HR over clean beats
feature_definitions.rmssd_rel: RMSSD of consecutive clean IBIs / mean clean IBI
feature_definitions.pnn50: share of consecutive clean IBI differences above 50 ms
feature_definitions.ppg_amp_cv: sd / mean of beat amplitude (band-passed PPG peak minus the minimum since the previous peak)
feature_definitions.ppg_amp_slope_rel: least-squares slope of beat amplitude per minute / mean beat amplitude

emotion_mapping: P > 0.65 Angry, P > 0.5 Happy, otherwise Relaxed

scan.rule: skip up to settle_seconds at the start (the Shimmer start-up transient) while keeping at least min_seconds; cut the rest into 60 s windows (30 s hop) and average P; a remainder shorter than 60 s is scored as one window (less reliable). The app streams at 51.2 Hz: on CUADS that gives the same AUC (0.599-0.601 vs 0.606 at 128 Hz).
